correctness.rationale: Exact prefix/suffix separation is valid for all binary codewords with forbidden overlap 1. For n>=14 the middle 2^(n-14) factor is exact. A finite 64-by-64 mask computation with include/exclude exhaustion and mathematically safe cardinality and dominated-state pruning proves max product=744. Forward/reverse transpose searches independently agree (9209/9191 nodes); small cases 1..6 match published values and cutoffs 1..4 are directly enumerated. The known 24-by-31 witness attains the bound. No finite extrapolation is used for the all-length factorization.
